verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.he: יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּיֹ֣ום צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.ar: لِيَسْتَجِبْ لَكَ ٱلرَّبُّ فِي يَوْمِ ٱلضِّيقِ. لِيَرْفَعْكَ ٱسْمُ إِلَهِ يَعْقُوبَ.
verses.en: The LORD answer thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;
verses.kjv: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.web: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

verses.ar: لِيُرْسِلْ لَكَ عَوْنًا مِنْ قُدْسِهِ، وَمِنْ صِهْيَوْنَ لِيَعْضُدْكَ.
verses.en: Send forth thy help from the sanctuary, and support thee out of Zion;
verses.kjv: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.web: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

verses.ar: لِيَذْكُرْ كُلَّ تَقْدِمَاتِكَ، وَيَسْتَسْمِنْ مُحْرَقَاتِكَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Receive the memorial of all thy meal-offerings, and accept the fat of thy burnt-sacrifice; Selah
verses.kjv: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.web: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

verses.ar: لِيُعْطِكَ حَسَبَ قَلْبِكَ، وَيُتَمِّمْ كُلَّ رَأْيِكَ.
verses.en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.kjv: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.web: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

verses.he: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה ׀ בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁאֲלֹותֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: نَتَرَنَّمُ بِخَلَاصِكَ، وَبِٱسْمِ إِلَهِنَا نَرْفَعُ رَايَتَنَا. لِيُكَمِّلِ ٱلرَّبُّ كُلَّ سُؤْلِكَ.
verses.en: We will shout for joy in thy victory, and in the name of our God we will set up our standards; the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.kjv: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up [our] banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.web: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.

verses.he: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הֹושִׁ֥יעַ ׀ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יחֹ֥ו יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשֹׁ֑ו בִּ֝גְבֻרֹ֗ות יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֹֽו׃
verses.ar: اَلْآنَ عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ مُخَلِّصُ مَسِيحِهِ، يَسْتَجِيبُهُ مِنْ سَمَاءِ قُدْسِهِ، بِجَبَرُوتِ خَلَاصِ يَمِينِهِ.
verses.en: Now know I that the LORD saveth His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven with the mighty acts of His saving right hand.
verses.kjv: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.web: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.he: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ ׀ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بِٱلْمَرْكَبَاتِ وَهَؤُلَاءِ بِٱلْخَيْلِ، أَمَّا نَحْنُ فَٱسْمَ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِنَا نَذْكُرُ.
verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; but we will make mention of the name of the LORD our God.
verses.kjv: Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
verses.web: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.

verses.he: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעֹודָֽד׃
verses.ar: هُمْ جَثَوْا وَسَقَطُوا، أَمَّا نَحْنُ فَقُمْنَا وَٱنْتَصَبْنَا.
verses.en: They are bowed down and fallen; but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.kjv: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.web: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

verses.ar: يَا رَبُّ خَلِّصْ! لِيَسْتَجِبْ لَنَا ٱلْمَلِكُ فِي يَوْمِ دُعَائِنَا!
verses.en: Save, LORD; let the King answer us in the day that we call.
verses.kjv: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.web: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
